pkgmetadata.longdescription: TruffleHog scans for leaked credentials in git history, filesystems, S3 buckets, container images and many other sources. What sets it apart from a pure pattern matcher is verification: for hundreds of credential types it calls the provider to check whether the secret is still live, which separates a real incident from a rotated key. It complements dev-vcs/gitleaks rather than replacing it, the latter being the lighter pre-commit-shaped option.
